title: Enrich the same planned case with step implementation evidence
preconditions: A disposable Saga contains a planned feature, story and acceptance criterion; no test code or runs are required to author the case.

steps.action: Author a planned case with preconditions, ordered steps, expected outcomes and a criterion relation, without evidence or runs; open it through Roadmap.
steps.expected_result: The canonical case reader displays the planned stage, assertion outcome and criterion link without runs.

steps.action: Append implementation evidence to the assertion step, leaving setup unmapped; inspect the evidence identity and follow the assertion evidence link.
steps.expected_result: The assertion names its canonical evidence and opens its evidence record; setup remains valid without links.

steps.action: Promote the feature to built and open its same named case from the feature page.
steps.expected_result: The implemented case reader displays the implementation-linked definition.

steps.action: Compare the case identity and browser URL before and after implementation and promotion.
steps.expected_result: The case identity and canonical reader URL are unchanged.

expected_result: Enrich the same planned case with step implementation evidence.
